important_findings: Historical sources distinguish uncontrolled draft from intentional seasonal ventilation; a binary 'wind good/bad' model is invalid.
A reported historical even-window/odd-door idea exists through a secondary quotation, but its original textual chain is not yet verified.
Vietnam's energy-code migration is time-sensitive: QCVN 09:2017/BXD remains current on 2026-09-01, while QCVN 04-3:2026/BXD takes effect 2027-02-01.
A general civil-building QCVN 04-1 draft is currently under consultation and must not be treated as law.
